name: Felix's Box
summary: In Frostmane camps southwest of Anvilmar, Felix's Box lies far from the gnome refugee who lost it.

sections.title: Lost in the Flight from Gnomeregan
sections.body: Radiation swept through Gnomeregan during the failed attempt to purge the trogg menace. Felix Whindlebolt fled with the gnomes into Coldridge Valley, leaving his possessions and crafting gear along the snowy road to escape the fumes. Frostmane trolls plundered the goods before he could return. They carried his box, chest, and bucket of bolts to their settlements southwest of Anvilmar.

sections.title: A Refugee's Quandary
sections.body: Felix is unused to violence and poorly suited to Dun Morogh's wilderness. He needs passing adventurers in Anvilmar to help recover his belongings. Their return would restore some normalcy and give the displaced artisan the means to earn a living. He lost everything when Gnomeregan fell.

faq.answer: Felix's Box holds Felix Whindlebolt's personal belongings. He is a gnome artisan who fled Gnomeregan after radiation spread through the city.

faq.q: How did the box end up with the Frostmane trolls?
aliases: why do trolls have felixs box
faq.answer: Felix left his gear while fleeing the radioactive fumes from Gnomeregan. Frostmane trolls carried the roadside goods to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.
Felix Whindlebolt is a gnome refugee in Anvilmar. Gnomeregan's fall traumatized him and left him without his tools or personal belongings.

faq.q: What other items did Felix lose?
faq.answer: The Frostmane trolls took Felix's Chest and Bucket of Bolts along with the box. They carried all three to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

angles.text: As a gnome starting in Coldridge Valley, you can help a fellow exile by recovering Felix's belongings after Gnomeregan's evacuation.
As an engineer, you know how hard it is for displaced gnome craftsmen to lose the tools and containers they rely on.
